title: Cousances / Le Creuset – Cast Iron Casserole Dish – Model 16 – 31 cm – Very Rare Collector’s Piece
description:
Magnificent collector’s casserole dish by Cousances, a historic French brand now integrated into Le Creuset. Cousances is considered the high-end heritage line of French enameled cast iron cookware.
Model 16, 31 cm, crafted from thick enameled cast iron, offering excellent heat distribution and even cooking performance. A true professional-quality kitchen piece, built to last a lifetime.
Cousances pieces are now highly rare and sought after by collectors, following the brand’s discontinuation in the 1980s after its acquisition by Le Creuset in 1957. These items represent an important part of French culinary heritage and craftsmanship.
Brand: Cousances (Le Creuset)
Model: 16
Material: enameled cast iron
Compatibility: all hobs, including induction
Condition: vintage, good condition (see photos, they are part of the description)
These iconic pieces carry the traditional expertise of Cousances, renowned for its exceptional quality before being absorbed into Le Creuset. They are now highly prized for their durability, authenticity, and historical value.
Perfect for stews, roasts, soups, or bread baking, combining outstanding cooking performance with French culinary heritage.
